---
// The astro-check format's sample: one type error in the frontmatter, an
// untyped parameter, and a value that may be null in a client script.
const count: number = "three";
function twice(n) {
	return n * 2;
}
---

<p>{count} {twice(2)}</p>
<script>
	const node = document.getElementById("x");
	node.textContent = "y";
</script>
